assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated transparent 2D projectile sprite for a painterly top-down fantasy action game mixing eastern cultivation fantasy and western alchemy. Primary request: a single compact ROUND musket ball, spherical dark forged iron, hand-engraved fine aged gold runic grooves, one restrained warm ember inset, subtle worn surface and metal highlights. Not a cartridge or a pointed bullet: ONLY a spherical iron shot, no casing, no flat base, no fins. Design reads beautifully when shrunk to 16 pixels; strong simple silhouette, distinct dark lower right and softly lit upper left. Three-quarter overhead camera, orthographic perspective, physically shaded hand-painted game art, antiqued bronze accents, muted iron grey and amber, NOT photoreal modern military equipment and NOT pixel art. Composition: exactly one sphere centered, occupies about 65 percent image width, small free margin, transparent alpha background. No scene, hands, gun, stand, ground, cast shadow, outer glow, trail, particles, text, labels, frame, grid or watermark. Genuine transparent background; keep the entire sphere opaque except background.
